newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lojas Renner started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lojas Renner started.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it had started coverage of Brazilian retailer Lojas Renner with a buy rating.

-- "We like Renner's clear goals, top-notch management, profitability and productivity. Renner's attractive features come at a discount," analysts Julio Zamora and John McCormack wrote in a November 18 report.
-- "Renner trades at a 36 percent discount in estimated 1997 price/earnings to its peers in Latin America and has the highest net margin of Latin American department stores.
-- "... Our 12-month price target of $63.47 is based on 11 times estimated 1997 earnings."
Monday at 50 reais. The real trades at 1.03 to the dollar.
